mission_04: Great work! You have implemented Isolation Forest, one of the most effective and efficient anomaly detection algorithms. By exploiting the fact that anomalies are few and different, the algorithm isolates them with fewer random splits than normal points. The ensemble approach provides robust scores that can be used for both binary classification and ranking of anomalies. Isolation Forest excels in high-dimensional settings where distance-based methods struggle, and its linear time complexity makes it suitable for large datasets. The contamination parameter lets you control the expected proportion of anomalies, while the decision function provides continuous scores for flexible thresholding. This algorithm is widely used in fraud detection, network security, and industrial quality monitoring.
